ch04_demo1_power_inverse_iteration.mp4.title: Demo 1: Power and inverse iteration
ch04_demo1_power_inverse_iteration.mp4.howto: Open this tab next to the video. The video shows how to use the controls, explains power, inverse and Rayleigh quotient iteration, and then runs six experiments in the demo with what you should see. Pause it to try each one yourself.

ch04_demo2_qr_iteration_shifts.mp4.title: Demo 2: QR iteration with shifts
ch04_demo2_qr_iteration_shifts.mp4.howto: Open this tab next to the video. The video shows how to use the controls, explains QR iteration and its shifts, and then runs experiments with and without shifts in the demo. Pause it to try each one yourself.
